text:
Hannah: Thanks for the all-hands infra update. Dropping a short follow-up thread with Qs about APAC GPU supply and autoscaler fallbacks.
Leo: Pilot regions: SYD (primary) + BOM (sibling). Focused on Reserved capacity for Dedicated and optional Burst for Hosted.
Priya: Burst = spot-backed shared pool for Hosted. It will not evict Dedicated reservations. If spot is reclaimed we try a graceful drain (~20s); abrupt evictions return 502 with a trace id.
Marcus: How will this surface in Console? Customers worried about surprise egress/billing.
Leo: Console plan: (1) org-level "allow_cross_region_fallback" opt-in toggle, (2) preview estimated cross-region egress before enabling, (3) burst allowance UI and alerts when burst spend exceeds thresholds. No surprise billing without opt-in.
Priya: Data residency control: route config `residency_mode` = `preferred|strict`. When `strict` is set autoscaler will not route out of region and will return 429 + header `x-rdi-reason: residency-block`.
Hannah: SRE request: please add `region` + `model_variant` tags to cold-start metrics and publish median + p95 for APAC pilot. Customers want realistic SLAs.
sre-bot: Job created: tag-coldstart-metrics -> queued for next run.
Marcus: Cold-start targets we've been discussing: node provision <= 90s; model load median ~20s (7B), ~40s (13B), up to ~80s (70B). We'll pre-warm hot variants.
Priya: Action items I own: open API PR to add `residency_mode` enum by Thu, and add clear error header text; Console to mock burst allowance UI next sprint.
Hannah: Great, I'll collate PR links and a one-paragraph customer FAQ (spot eviction behavior) and post in #product-update later today. :thumbsup:
